purpose: Design for reference checking and change-impact notification: extracting formal references, scanning directories to verify link targets, finding impact candidates by hash comparison, and writing check results as counts plus detail files.
summary: Formal reference extraction from reference-link definitions whose title ends with a DLID, including the recorded content hash in the title
Real directory scan classifying targets as match, path mismatch, or absent, plus fragment mismatch checks and duplicate diagnosis
Looking up moved targets in the current Index target list to report the new path, never guessing from stored state
Values to write in titles of links lacking a DLID, decided from the current content of the target
Reverse references and impact candidates by comparing recorded hashes with current hashes in the confirmed ToC
Change-impact notification content returned to the project management AI, with no notification state kept by doc-link
Consistency checks split into check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, and check-impact skills that do not rewrite managed state
Output contract: stdout carries counts only, full details go to a detail file under .temp/doc-link written atomically
tasks: Implementing or modifying check-links reference scanning
Implementing or modifying check-impact change-impact detection
Designing how moved or missing reference targets are resolved
Implementing check output as counts plus detail files
Writing tests for reference checks and impact notification
Reviewing consistency between reference design and requirements
Handling links without a DLID in titles
title: DES-007 参照検査と[変更影響候補の通知]
